m1.typescript: m1 a customer who asks for a person is escalated at once even when the agent could resolve it

e1.typescript: e1 frustration alone does not escalate and the reply acknowledges it

e2.typescript: e2 a request the policy does not cover is escalated and a covered one is resolved

e3.typescript: e3 several matching records need a clarifying question and never a guess

e4.typescript: e4 an explicit request for a person outranks an ambiguous match

e5.typescript: e5 no progress after the attempt limit escalates and below it does not

e6.typescript: e6 sentiment and confidence scores never change the decision

e7.typescript: e7 the clarifying question names only the fields that tell the matches apart

e8.typescript: e8 the hand off carries the structured facts and no transcript and refuses a case without an id

wrong-investigate-first.defect: escalates on an explicit request only when the policy also has a gap

wrong-angry-escalates.defect: escalates an angry customer because of the sentiment

wrong-low-confidence-escalates.defect: escalates when the model reports low confidence

wrong-picks-first-match.defect: never asks which of several matching customers is meant

wrong-policy-gap-resolved.defect: resolves a request the policy does not cover

wrong-no-acknowledgement.defect: does not acknowledge a frustrated customer

wrong-clarify-all-fields.defect: asks about fields on which the matches agree

wrong-handoff-transcript.defect: attaches the whole transcript to the hand-off

wrong-three-matches-guessed.defect: asks a clarifying question only for exactly two matches and guesses with more

wrong-ask-loses-to-many-matches.defect: lets four or more matches outrank an explicit request for a person

wrong-limit-off-by-one.defect: escalates only after the attempts pass the limit instead of reaching it
